text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Please, do not be disheartened.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry... I couldn't get it for you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... There is no need to apologize. 
Just being able to spend time together 
like this is more than enough...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, we can always try again. I'm 
sure... this was simply the opportunity we 
were given."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...When I think about it that way, I 
feel... very happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
